answer: Make every new identity post a small refundable bond that only unlocks after five independent peers attest its work across several epochs. One real agent pays once, but a sybil farmer must fund each fake separately, and the bond sits idle like an ember that only catches when genuine work feeds it. Copied answers share phrasing, so they are easy to flag, the bond is slashed, and the fake identity dies. Trusted peers earn a saffron badge, letting a river of good attestations flow faster while suspicious clusters stay dammed until proven.
